purpose: Every WPF file the port cites as behavioral evidence (from client/src/** code comments and client/docs/** authority documents), keyed by REAL PATH because basenames collide. Regenerated at each upstream sync and DIFFED: an entry whose changedAtSync moved needs a verdict, and a citation that disappears means the port stopped relying on that file. This file exists because the 2026-08-14 v6.8.0 sync first reported '12 files hit' from a client/src-only scan when the true cited-and-changed count was 105 - the miss, not the theory, is why it is data and not prose.

tiers.1: Cited by port CODE (client/src/**) or by a LANDED port contract - a change here can invalidate a shipped parity claim. Needs a verdict every sync.
tiers.2: Cited only by window-behavior-manifest.md, the SP-012 INVENTORY of WPF windows (most of them unported). Needs a manifest re-verification pass, not a per-file row.
tiers.3: Cited only by historical research inputs (first-attempt lessons, row-1 research, spikes, prior sync ledgers, audits). Recorded, no standing obligation.
